pages.text: Water seeps through rock by $(thing)Darcy's law$(): Q = kAΔP/(μL) - permeability times the pressure gradient. The $(item)Aquifer Pump$() draws it up: Water anywhere; in the Planetary Interior, an $(item)Aquifer Sample$() with Deep Brine from a confined aquifer.
In the Interior's Magma Chambers it reaches water heated past its critical point, 647 K and 22 MPa: $(fluid)Supercritical Water$(), neither liquid nor gas.
